title: cleanup_tmp_files aborts scan on first entry error
description: When tokio::fs::read_dir().next_entry() returns Err (e.g. transient I/O error mid-scan), cleanup_tmp_files hits the 'Err(e) => { warn\!(...); break; }' arm and exits the loop. Any remaining .msg.tmp/.env.tmp files in the queue dir are left unprocessed. On a dir with many entries and one bad inode, orphan tmp files survive startup cleanup silently. Same pattern in cleanup_orphan_msg_files. The break should be a continue (or the loop should retry the entry).
